🔄 Built-In Software Update Wizard

Effortless Updates That Respect Your Computer & Files

Whether you install one RaggieSoft app or the whole family, keeping up with new features is always on your schedule.

🔄 Shared Software Update Wizard

Click "Check for Updates" inside RaggieSoft Launcher—or inside the About window of any RaggieSoft app—to check all of your installed RaggieSoft apps in one step.

🪄 Step-by-Step or One-Click Quiet Mode

Prefer seeing every setup screen? Leave Quick Install unchecked. Prefer updating in a single click? Turn on Quick Install inside Launcher for smooth, hands-free updates.

👤 Works With or Without Administrator Access

Install for everyone on a family PC, or choose "Install for me only" to set up RaggieSoft apps inside your personal account folder with zero administrator password prompts.

Express Setup vs. Custom Setup — Your Choice Every Time

Inspired by classic desktop setup wizards that respected power users while staying effortless for newcomers, every RaggieSoft installer offers two clear paths right after the open-culture license screen:

  • Express Setup (Recommended): Skips straight to installing with standard Start Menu shortcuts and default settings in a single click.
  • Custom Setup: Lets you pick a custom installation folder, choose Desktop & Start Menu shortcuts, pre-load offline books, or customize double-click behavior in StoreTrainer.
  • Thoughtful Uninstaller: Uninstalling RaggieSoft Launcher even shows a live checklist of your other installed RaggieSoft apps—with every data-removal box unchecked by default so you never lose books, music, or game profiles by mistake!
